description: Visual verification (MEASUREMENT ONLY): render an HTML file with headless Chromium INSIDE this server (does NOT use the user's own browser) and compare it to the Figma design PNG. Returns SSIM (0-1, higher = closer), pixel-diff %, and clustered diff regions (bounding boxes of disagreement, in logical px). Provide the HTML as htmlPath (local file) or html (inline document) and the reference PNG via figmaUrl (auto-fetched), figmaPngPath, or figmaPngBase64. Use after generating HTML to objectively check fidelity, then fix only the reported regions — this tool never changes code. Requires Playwright Chromium: `npx playwright install chromium`.

bg.description: Background [r,g,b] to flatten transparent reference-PNG pixels onto before comparing. Default [255,255,255]. For dark designs pass the real background (e.g. [13,17,23]) — otherwise transparent areas read as a false full diff.

clip.description: Optional [x,y,w,h] in CSS/logical px to compare ONLY the content area. Use it to exclude dead margins / parent-canvas background that the isolated frame cannot reproduce (that noise otherwise dominates the regions and masks real content diffs). Region coords are reported back in full-frame coords.

figmaPngBase64.description: Alternative: base64 of the reference PNG.

figmaPngPath.description: Alternative to figmaUrl: local path to an already-saved reference PNG.

figmaUrl.description: Figma node URL — reference PNG fetched automatically at the given scale.

frameWidth.description: Figma frame width in CSS px (e.g. 1440 or 1920). HTML is rendered at this width.

html.description: The full self-contained HTML document as a string (inline CSS, images as data: or https URLs). Alternative to htmlPath; required on a hosted server. Max 5 MB.

htmlPath.description: Absolute path to the generated .html file to render (local servers only). Provide exactly one of htmlPath or html.

outDir.description: Directory for the diff image (default: $FIGMA_PROXY_VERIFY_DIR or <os temp dir>/figma-proxy-mcp/verify-out).

returnImage.description: Also return the diff image (PNG, downscaled to logical px) as MCP image content. Default false locally, true on a hosted server.

scale.description: Device scale factor for render and reference (default 2 — match render_node_png).

name: verify_render
